revision_reason: Canonical main advanced during the same Trigger-2 cycle and landed a second/full-tuple labeler lane plus an event-ancestry v2 successor. This audit re-enters those exact-current sources and prevents the new v2 from being mistaken for a closed D/E labelability gate.
v2_positive_deltas: Separates exact evidence-event identity from correlation ancestry and preserves distinct correlated observations for audit.
Exact event replay is idempotent at the branch update surface.
Correlated observations can be retained without granting independent-evidence credit.
Preserves branch-local E_plus/E_minus/F and context-filtering semantics rather than deleting alternatives.
Discriminator ordering includes pair separation and worst-case indistinguishable partition before ordinal risk/cost classes.
Salience ordering remains separate from truth/probability semantics.
Source tests add event-vs-ancestry, context filtering, branch permutation and correlated-majority anti-collapse cases.

promotion_blockers.observed: u_state still consumes observation.relation directly. No exact-current source in this lane derives SUPPORTS/COUNTERS/FALSIFIES from a synthetic world relation, branch prediction and observed discriminator result.
promotion_blockers.risk: The missing target label can still be moved upstream into generator metadata; deterministic code does not make a self-asserted relation correct.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: A separately versioned deterministic synthetic-world relation deriver or adjudicated evidence receipt whose inputs/outputs can be independently recomputed by the candidate gate.

promotion_blockers.observed: independent_credit is granted when ancestry has not been seen and observation.independence_qualified is true. independence_group is recorded but is not itself used to reject/mark correlated a distinct event with a different ancestry identifier but the same dependence group.
promotion_blockers.risk: A generator can mint independent-evidence credit by changing ancestry and asserting independence_qualified, even when the declared dependence group remains shared.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Derive/verify independence from immutable causal/provenance grouping rules. Same declared dependence group must not receive independent credit unless the group semantics explicitly define otherwise.

promotion_blockers.observed: Exact replay detection keys primarily on evidence_event_id. If the same event id reappears with conflicting relation/ancestry/provenance metadata, the updater can silently skip it instead of failing closed on identity mutation.
promotion_blockers.risk: Contradictory replay payloads can be hidden by idempotence rather than exposed as provenance corruption.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Bind event id to an immutable canonical event digest and reject same-id/different-digest replay.

promotion_blockers.observed: v2 d_resolve(state) returns PASS whenever exactly one APPLIES branch remains non-falsified and no live UNKNOWN-context branch remains. Unlike the full-tuple v1 lane, v2 does not require an explicit executed+admissible discriminator/proof context.
promotion_blockers.risk: Because FALSIFIES is still caller-supplied, arbitrary upstream relation metadata can eliminate competitors and create a unique survivor that resolves without proof that a real discriminator was executed or adequate.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Restore an explicit machine-checkable discriminator execution/admissibility/coverage receipt, or derive resolution directly from a deterministic world/test evaluator that proves the observed outcome uniquely separates all live applicable branches.

promotion_blockers.observed: v2 tests construct v/K/E_plus/E_minus/F/T/A/sigma/projection_visibility, but the implementation does not validate the full mandatory tuple or allowed enum/schema constraints before updating/resolving.
promotion_blockers.risk: Malformed or partial branches can enter the reference path and acquire labels despite violating the cross-cutting Hyperposition ontology.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Add exact schema validation for all mandatory branch-state fields and reject unknown/missing semantics before target generation.

promotion_blockers.observed: new_branch_payload is accepted when branch_creation_warranted is true, but the warrant itself is caller-provided and no deterministic counterhypothesis-birth rule is computed.
promotion_blockers.risk: Synthetic positive targets can invent branches without a reproducible rule, defeating reference-label correctness.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Version and derive branch-birth conditions from the synthetic task/world relation, or keep branch birth out of admitted positive D/E rows until such a rule exists.

promotion_blockers.observed: u_test_order computes useful ordinal ranking from test.outcomes, but the per-branch outcomes themselves are caller/generator data and are not derived or verified in this source.
promotion_blockers.risk: A generator can fabricate a high-utility test by fabricating outcome partitions.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Bind discriminator predicted outcomes to the same synthetic world/evaluator used to derive evidence relations, then rank the derived partitions.

convergence_contract: There must be one current D/E label semantics, not parallel semantic_hyperposition-v1, hyperposition-v1 and hyperposition-v2 authorities.
Fuse full-tuple fail-closed schema validation from the stricter lane with v2 exact-event/correlation-ancestry preservation.
Introduce a separately versioned deterministic relation/world evaluator so relation, independence and discriminator partitions are derived, not asserted.
Require same-event immutable payload digest equality; conflicting replay is a hard failure.
Restore explicit executed/admissible/adequate discriminator evidence before unique resolution, unless equivalent coverage is mechanically derived from the synthetic world evaluator.
Keep probability-free test/salience ordering and canonical-truth/effect nonauthority boundaries.
Only after the successor passes exact source tests plus model-visible leakage gates may positive synthetic D/E candidate rows be generated for Forge/Distillery admission.

external_research_reaffirmation.variable_binding: Wu, Geiger & Milliere, ICML 2025: developmental and causal study of learned variable dereferencing supports multi-hop/distractor/checkpoint/causal binder evaluation; it is method input, not Qwen-specific proof.
external_research_reaffirmation.uncertainty: Semantic-uncertainty/set-abstention literature may inform evaluation of unresolved alternatives, but must not substitute for deterministic branch semantics or truth authority.

coordination.pr_2009: Reviewed/commented during this cycle; instructed to converge with exact-current main rather than introduce a second label authority and to bind synthetic relation derivation independently of generator assertions.

next_exact_action: Implement or fuse one derivation-bound full-tuple Hyperposition labeler successor: exact synthetic world/test specification -> independently recomputed branch relations + independence qualification + discriminator partitions -> U update -> explicit adequate resolution; then add mutation tests for forged relation, forged independence, same-event/different-payload replay, missing tuple fields, nonexecuted discriminator, and fabricated test outcomes before generating positive D/E rows.
